register: R1 screen-print editorial — riso grain, limited inks (rust/teal/mustard/cream), registration drift. Locked by Daniel 2026-07-29 (revocable). Full doctrine in visual-kit/style-bible.md.

everyman.role: THE EVERYMAN — the channel's recurring viewer-proxy; the human whose ordinary action opens every video. Not named on screen.
everyman.costume: PINNED canonical look (charD 'slim-urban editorial', Daniel pick 2026-07-29): slim elongated silhouette, navy-blue open overcoat over an olive crew-neck sweater, navy trousers, dark shoes, orange-rust messenger bag worn cross-body, short dark side-parted hair, understated minimal face. Every appearance renders in this unless a shot deliberately authors a change (season/context swaps allowed, silhouette is the identity).

coffee-shop.role: The wedge interior — where the tap happens; recurring cold-open environment.

machine-hall.role: Generic 'inside the system' infrastructure hall — racks, cable trays, cold blue-teal inks, one warm accent, human silhouette for scale.

street-corner.role: Night street exterior of the corner shop — the walk-away / world-above environment; wet-pavement reflections, warm window against teal night.

mechanism-cutaway.role: HYBRID MECHANISM MODE exemplar — R6 clear-line cutaway grammar rendered in R1's ink palette with LOCKED registration (no drift) for how-it-works beats. Approved via watchability probe 2026-07-29. Rules live in style-bible.md; this frame is the visual anchor.

data-card.role: DATA-CARD exemplar — flat high-contrast stat card on the register's paper-grain background, type shapes untextured; the only text-bearing frame type. Approved via watchability probe 2026-07-29 (probe N6). Law in style-bible.md §2d.
